protocol.cost: Observed episode wall time and actual enumerated longer-horizon sequences; no timing acceptance threshold or speedup claim

protocol.selection: Train only; unchanged recovery gates against frozen_h1 and matched frozen horizon; highest summed goal gain against frozen_h1, then lexical arm name
